summary: Huai'an Lianshui International Airport (HIA) is a modern civil aviation facility serving Huai'an, a culturally significant city in northern Jiangsu Province, China, and the birthplace of former Premier Zhou Enlai. Located in Lianshui County about 20 km east of central Huai'an, the airport supports both domestic passenger routes and cargo operations for the surrounding Huai River basin region. The facility has grown in importance as a regional hub connecting Huai'an to major Chinese cities.
faqs:
Q: How far is Huai'an Lianshui Airport from the city center?
A: The airport is located approximately 20 km (12 miles) east of central Huai'an, with typical journey times of 30-40 minutes by road depending on traffic.

Q: Does the airport operate international flights?
A: The airport primarily serves domestic routes to major Chinese cities. International service availability may vary, so travelers should check current schedules with their airline.

Q: What facilities are available at the terminal?
A: The terminal provides standard amenities including check-in counters, security screening, waiting lounges, food and beverage outlets, and ground transportation services.

Q: Are there nearby hotels for early morning or late-night flights?
A: Yes, several hotels and guesthouses can be found in the Lianshui area and along the route into Huai'an city, catering to travelers with unusual flight times.
transport_tips: Taxis and ride-hailing services like Didi are readily available at the arrivals curb and offer the most convenient transfer to Huai'an city center. Airport shuttle buses operate on scheduled routes connecting the terminal with key points in Huai'an at a lower cost than private taxis. For travelers heading to Lianshui town itself, the airport is just a short drive away.
local_tip: If you have a long layover or early arrival, ask a local driver to take you to Zhou Enlai's Former Residence and Memorial Hall in central Huai'an—it is one of the most well-preserved historical sites dedicated to the former Chinese Premier and offers free admission to most sections.
